== Links ==

Hello. Thanks for creating an account. I wanted to let you know of one of our help pages, the [[Help:Style guide|Style guide]]. The reason I bring this up is because of the links you were adding. There isn't a need to place a link every time something or someone is mentioned. Once per article is usually sufficient, with longer articles getting a second link to another page if it has been several sections since it was linked. Also, it isn't necessary to link an article on it's own page, such as the ones on Egwene's page. As you can see, this only bolds the link instead of turning it into a link, like this: [[User talk:Silver mint]]. Please let me know if you have any questions. Again, thanks for joining us and I hope to see you around! ---- {{User:Mainphramephreak/Sig/Subst}} 14:04, March 14, 2013 (UTC)
